qa.topFinding: All 11 MCP packages + trigger-matcher have tests. 1,327+ total tests across workspaces. 56 script tests covering versioning infrastructure: generate-version-index.test.mjs (31 tests), manifest-helper.test.sh (19 tests), update-component.test.sh (6 tests). Frontmatter validator checks 64+ files with 0 errors/0 warnings. Version index validates 86 components.
qa.recommendation: Add test:scripts to CI pipeline as a dedicated job. Add integration tests for cross-server scenarios.
qa.riskIfIgnored: Low remaining risk - comprehensive test coverage across all components

uiux.topFinding: PM dashboard (TUI + web) has dark/light theme toggle (persisted in localStorage), keyboard navigation (J/K section nav, T theme toggle, R refresh, ? help), ARIA-friendly focusable cards. Multi-project view also themed. Primarily a CLI toolkit, so UI needs are limited.
uiux.recommendation: Add collapsible sections and responsive mobile layout improvements
uiux.riskIfIgnored: Low risk - UI is secondary to this project's purpose

security.topFinding: 59 sanitizePath() calls with basePath=process.cwd(). 10 execFile() calls, 0 raw exec() calls (no shell injection). CI secrets scan fails build on findings. npm audit warns on high-severity vulns. update-component.sh uses node -e for JSON (no eval injection). .gitignore prevents accidental secret commits.
security.recommendation: Add SQL injection protection to database-operations. Add Content-Security-Policy headers if web dashboard is exposed.
security.riskIfIgnored: Low remaining risk - major attack vectors are closed

devops.topFinding: CI pipeline: 14+ jobs with dedicated test-scripts job, benchmark trend detection (downloads previous artifact, compares per-server build times, warns on >20% regression). Branch protection on main with 9 required status checks (strict mode). Pre-commit hooks via husky + lint-staged. ShellCheck validates all bash scripts.
devops.recommendation: Consider adding required PR reviews for external contributors. Add Dependabot for automated dependency updates.
devops.riskIfIgnored: Low remaining risk - comprehensive CI/CD with branch protection in place

networking.topFinding: Stdio transport (minimal exposure). runServer() provides health check framework. rag-mcp, code-review-mcp, and testing-mcp use startup health checks via commandHealthCheck(). URL sanitization blocks SSRF.
networking.recommendation: Add periodic health checks for long-running servers
networking.riskIfIgnored: Low remaining risk - all exec-based servers verify tool availability at startup

development.topFinding: npm workspaces monorepo with 12 packages. Shared tsconfig.base.json (all 11 tsconfigs extend it). ESLint zero-tolerance (--max-warnings 0). Pre-commit hooks via husky + lint-staged. Clean working tree - v2.3.0 committed, tagged, pushed, and released.
development.recommendation: Add tsc --noEmit to pre-commit hooks for MCP servers. Consider adding workspace constraint checks.
development.riskIfIgnored: Low remaining risk - comprehensive development guardrails in place

architecture.topFinding: npm workspaces monorepo with 12 packages and shared tsconfig.base.json. Per-component versioning with 86-component index (component-versions.json). Manifest v2 with per-component tracking. All 10 servers use runServer() factory from mcp-shared. 5 ADRs document key decisions. update-component.sh enables granular updates.
architecture.recommendation: Consider workspace-level dependency constraints to prevent phantom deps. Add ADRs for future decisions.
architecture.riskIfIgnored: Low remaining risk - clean monorepo architecture with documented decisions

product.topFinding: 86 distributable components: 46 agents, 19 skills, 10 MCP servers, 3 hooks, 6 plugins, 2 integrations. Per-component versioning enables granular updates. /update-check v2.0.0 with fuzzy matching and changelog display. v2.3.0 released on GitHub. 90 total commits, 2 GitHub releases (v1.0.0, v2.3.0).
product.recommendation: Keep docs in sync with Claude Code CLI releases. Consider a web-based component browser. Plan v2.4.0 priorities.
product.riskIfIgnored: Users follow outdated guides as CLI evolves

api.topFinding: MCP tool interfaces are consistent. All use Zod validation, shared errorResponse() with actionable context. Standard response helpers from mcp-shared. runServer() provides unified lifecycle. 30+ MCP tools across 10 servers.
api.recommendation: Add input examples to tool descriptions for better discoverability
api.riskIfIgnored: Users may not understand expected input formats

monitoring.topFinding: 100% instrumentation. All 10 MCP servers auto-log tool activity to ~/.claude/mcp-activity.jsonl via registerTrackedToolHandler(). ActivityTracker records started/completed/failed status with requestId, durationMs, server name, tool name, and sanitized args. Log rotation at 5MB. MetricsCollector tracks per-tool p50/p95/p99 latencies. project-oversight-mcp provides get_tool_activity + get_active_tools for querying. HTTP dashboard has live Tool Activity panel with 3s auto-refresh.
monitoring.recommendation: Wire MetricsCollector.recordCall() into registerTrackedToolHandler for automated latency percentile tracking
monitoring.riskIfIgnored: Low remaining risk - comprehensive activity tracking across all servers

database.topFinding: rag-mcp healthCheck() wired into runServer() startup with retry logic. Adapter pattern supports ChromaDB, Qdrant, Redis. Graceful degradation on failure.
database.recommendation: Add periodic health checks and connection pool monitoring
database.riskIfIgnored: Post-startup connection drops still need manual detection

performance.topFinding: CI benchmark with trend detection: downloads previous run's artifact, compares per-server build times, warns on >5s increase per server or >20% total regression. 120s SLA enforced. npm workspaces dependency hoisting reduces install time. Single npm install for all 12 packages.
performance.recommendation: Consider tracking benchmark trends over time in a dashboard or summary report
performance.riskIfIgnored: Low remaining risk - automated regression detection in place

documentation.topFinding: Comprehensive documentation: README, QUICKSTART, CONTRIBUTING.md, CLAUDE.md, CHANGELOG. mcp-shared/API.md with full export reference and usage examples. docs/component-browser.html for interactive component discovery. All 10 MCP servers have CHANGELOG.md. All 86 components have standardized metadata. Full link audit: 59 broken links fixed across 18 files (0 broken links remaining).
documentation.recommendation: Add JSDoc/TSDoc comments to mcp-shared source for IDE tooltips. Consider auto-generating API docs.
documentation.riskIfIgnored: Low remaining risk - comprehensive documentation with verified links

specifications.topFinding: 5 Architecture Decision Records in docs/decisions/ document key decisions: mcp-shared extraction (001), per-component versioning (002), manifest v2 design (003), npm workspaces (004), CI pipeline design (005). MCP tool schemas serve as implicit API specs via Zod. component-versions.json schema is self-documenting.
specifications.recommendation: Add ADRs for future significant decisions. Consider formal spec for component-versions.json schema.
specifications.riskIfIgnored: Future decisions may lack documented rationale

projectDocs.topFinding: CHANGELOG.md tracks all versions (v1.3.0-v2.3.0). docs/decisions/ directory with 5 ADRs and index. Per-MCP-server CHANGELOG.md files (10 total). pm-dashboard.json tracks 29 tasks across 13 assessments. 2 GitHub releases with detailed notes. Auto-memory preserves cross-session context.
projectDocs.recommendation: Add retrospective documents after major milestones. Consider automated CHANGELOG generation from commit messages.
projectDocs.riskIfIgnored: Historical context for decisions may fade without written records

progress.topFinding: 35/35 tasks completed. v2.3.1 committed, tagged, pushed, and released on GitHub. 59 broken links fixed across 18 files. Clean working tree. All validation passing (lint 0 errors, frontmatter 0 errors, version index in sync). Project health score increased from initial 4.8 to 8.7 across 14 assessments.
progress.riskIfIgnored: No active risks - project is in excellent state
